newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman stock exchange says to open Salalah branch.
newsitem.headline: Oman stock exchange says to open Salalah branch.

text.p: The Muscat Securities Market plans to open a branch in Salalah in southern Oman by the end of the year, its executive vice president said in remarks published on Tuesday.
Ashraf Nabhan al-Nabhany was quoted by the daily Times of Oman newspaper as saying: "We have invited the one agent and two broker companies already based in Salalah to move into the same building."
Salalah is about 1,000 km south of the capital Muscat.
Nabhany also said the bourse planned soon to hand over the duties of its registrar department to the private sector.
